_comment: Hand-placed park pieces on Ulica Augusta Cesarca / Europski trg (tool frame: x east, z north). trees: extra [x, z] trees behind the Maketa grada Zagreba. props: same items as data/props.json (web3d/src/squareprops.ts): eu_garden (the ring of twelve stars on the lawn of Park medunarodnog priznanja Republike Hrvatske, with its two skylights) and wc_stairs (the closed underground toilet's stairwell with its steel-and-glass lift; its pit is the two regions 'WC stairwell' in data/levels.json). asphalt: polygons (tool frame) laid as carriageway: the Hotel Dubrovnik car park behind Praška ulica 6, closed to the walls round it (OSM's own outline stops short of them, leaving a raised sidewalk sliver); the parking_lot prop (web3d/src/parking.ts) paints its bays and parks the cars, its x, z the lot's north-west corner at the wall (bay frame: u along the north wall, v into the lot).
